Ollama provider sends the chat to /api/chat and maps the native reply, including token counts and finish reason

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"extra_body\":{\"num_ctx\":512,\"repeat_penalty\":1.1,\"top_k\":5},\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"ollama/qwen2:0.5b\"}")
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.choices[0].message.content)
    print(result.choices[0].finish_reason)
    print(result.model)
    print((result.usage.prompt_tokens if result.usage else None))
    print((result.usage.completion_tokens if result.usage else None))
    print((result.usage.total_tokens if result.usage else None))

asyncio.run(main())
```
